# Infalex 

> The complete ecosystem for AI automation, career acceleration, and developer tools.

## Website Purpose
Infalex is an India-based MSME-registered software initiative building ethical, practical AI tools for students, professionals, and developers.

## Content Sections
- /blog : The Knowledge Hub, featuring articles on AI, career advice, and engineering.
- /products/resumetra : An AI Resume Analyzer and Job Description Matcher.
- /about : Information about our MSME identity, company vision, and founding in 2026.
- /contact : Get in touch with us for support, feature requests, or business inquiries.

## Design System
The website is built with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. We employ a custom Design System tailored for a premium, dark-mode-first aesthetic with rich micro-interactions.

## Legal
- All tools and platforms are operated under Infalex's MSME registration.
- For legal inquiries, refer to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
